explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1175: for every uncountable κ there is a cardinal λ such that every graph with chromatic cardinal λ has a triangle-free subgraph of chromatic cardinal κ. It is not trivialised by choosing an unrealisable λ, since K_λ has chromatic number λ. Shelah's consistency result only rules out λ = κ = ℵ₁, so the general question is genuinely open, and stating it affirmatively is appropriate.
